entities.name: Bahawalpur Central Library
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Bahawalpur Central Library, also known as Sadiq Reading Library, is a public library in Bahawalpur, Punjab, Pakistan. It is the second largest library in the province of Punjab.
